title: Requite
description: A mod that adds souls to minecraft with blocks and items made from the souls
body:
This is a mod that alows the usage of magic to influence souls and that uses souls and magic to try and fix minecraft.Inspired by defile and charter .


for now this is heavy WIP as I don't know mutch coding.
Items
- unstable souls ( gotten from smelting soul sand/soil)
- souls ( unstable souls refined in a soul anchor )
- soul tether ( returns you to place of death )
- dark leather ( 3 black dye and a piece of leather )
- bone fraggments ( campfire bones )
- Wardstone ( activated with a soul stops all hostile mob spawns in 50,365,50 blocks)
- soul anchor ( makes unstable souls become stable )
